properties.summary: RadioNodeList DOM implementation for accessing radio button form controls, extending NodeList with value getter/setter for radio button groups.
Form constraint validation trait implementation for the HTML5 ValidityState API, providing the Validatable trait with check/report validity methods.
ValidityState and ValidationFlags implementations for HTML5 form constraint validation, tracking which validation errors are active on form elements.
Fullscreen API implementation for entering and exiting fullscreen mode on elements, managing fullscreen element state and promises.
Module re-export barrel file for the fullscreen API module.
Gamepad API implementation representing a physical gamepad connected to the system, exposing axes, buttons, pose, and haptic actuator.
GamepadButton DOM implementation for the W3C Gamepad specification, representing a single button on a gamepad with pressed/touched/value state.
GamepadEvent and GamepadEventType implementations for dispatching gamepad connected/disconnected events.
GamepadHapticActuator implementation supporting haptic feedback effects including dual-rumble vibration patterns.
GamepadPose DOM implementation for XR gamepad pose tracking with position, orientation, velocity, and acceleration data.
Module re-export barrel file for the gamepad module.
Geolocation API implementation providing getCurrentPosition and watchPosition with permission and secure-context checks.
GeolocationCoordinates DOM implementation for storing latitude, longitude, altitude, accuracy, heading, and speed data.
GeolocationPosition DOM implementation wrapping coordinates with a timestamp for the Geolocation API.
GeolocationPositionError DOM implementation for reporting geolocation errors with code and message.
Module re-export barrel file for the geolocation module.

Core GlobalScope implementation managing event loop, message ports, broadcast channels, blobs, workers, service workers, timers, microtasks, console APIs, GPU device tracking, ES module maps, fetch, and script execution context.
Module re-export barrel file for the globalscope module.
